title: Sound as a Longitudinal Wave
summary: Compressions and rarefactions: how vibrations travel through a medium, and why sound can't cross a vacuum.
objectives: I can describe sound as a longitudinal wave of compressions and rarefactions.
I can compare longitudinal and transverse waves.
I can explain why sound needs a medium.
misconceptions: The air travels from the source to your ear.
All waves move particles up and down.
